description: This file defines the Comment controller within the Opencart CMS module. It manages comment-related functionalities including displaying comments, adding new comments, replying, rating, and listing comments for blog articles. It interacts with models for articles and comments, utilizes URL generation, view rendering, and handles security tokens and captcha verification.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class for managing comments on CMS articles, including displaying, adding, replying, rating, and retrieving comment lists.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the comment section for an article, preparing data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of comments by calling the getList controller.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of comments for a specific article, with pagination, sorting, and reply handling.

methods.name: reply
methods.description: Outputs the replies for a specific comment.

methods.name: getReplies
methods.description: Fetches replies to a particular comment with pagination.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a new comment or reply, including validation, captcha, spam checks, and storing in the database.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Processes rating (upvote/downvote) for a specific comment, updating ratings in the database.
